create_swav_loss: create a SwAVLoss instance from an AttrDict configuration for self-supervised contrastive training
instantiate_swav_criterion: instantiate a SwAVCriterion with temperature, crops, prototypes, and queue parameters for SwAV loss computation
compute_swav_loss: compute the SwAV loss by calling forward with prototype scores tensors and target tensor
initialize_swav_queue: initialize the SwAV embedding queue buffers for distributed queue-based loss computation
update_swav_emb_queue: update the SwAV embedding queue with new embeddings for subsequent iteration queue usage
